rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a blastocyst with good ICM and looser B-grade TE, and appropriately notes uncertainty in expansion/collapse on a single image. Minor issue is speculating on 3AB vs 4AB inconsistency without image confirmation.

Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, smoking, male factor context, endometrial thickness, first-cycle status, and high-response fresh-cycle considerations with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to morphology and patient factors. Small limitation is some speculative emphasis on fresh-cycle endometrial disadvantage/OHSS without hormone data.

Recommendations are well aligned with IVF practice standards: elective single embryo transfer in a young patient, caution about OHSS in high responders, no routine add-ons, no routine PGT-A at age 23, and freeze-all if clinically indicated.

Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, OHSS monitoring, activity guidance, smoking cessation, cryopreservation strategy, and when to reassess protocol or male factor workup.
